panels.title: 冷开场：两张纸，同一个词
panels.prompt: A quiet modern hospital corridor in warm late-afternoon light, empty except for Lin and Kai. Kai sits on a simple bench holding two unmarked white documents: one is a generic discharge sheet with a small heart-related line icon, the other a generic laboratory report with a small upward-arrow icon and blank rows; absolutely no readable writing. He looks worried and younger than his usual confident self. Lin sits beside him, attentive, not touching the documents. No father, no patient, no doctors, no other people. Medium close shot, faces and the two sheets readable in composition, subdued suspense rather than melodrama.
panels.vfx: 化验单与出院单的文字、数值和「示意」角标全部后期叠加

panels.title: 先去看看，这个数数的是什么
panels.prompt:
Edit reference image 1, keeping the same two fictional people, their faces, clothes, the hospital corridor, cinematic warm lighting, and amber concentric scale-change ripples. Reference image 2 is Lin's identity sheet; reference image 3 is Kai's identity sheet.

The anatomical artery model on the table must become a simple healthy artery at normal scale. Show a smooth continuous clean vessel wall and an empty open lumen, a restrained red anatomical teaching model with no disease. Remove every yellow plaque deposit and every colored lipoprotein particle. Do not depict blood cells yet: the next shot will introduce them. Keep the artery model modestly sized on its table, with no dramatic obstruction or glowing lesion.

Lin wears her round exploration watch on her LEFT wrist and raises that wrist. Kai remains on her left in frame, holding two unmarked papers. Only these two people. No text, numbers, labels, logos, or additional UI. 16:9 cinematic educational storyboard keyframe, realistic fictional people, calm curiosity.

panels.title: 进入血流：先认识红细胞
panels.prompt: Inside a large artery at microscopic scale, a calm cinematic bloodstream filled with many smooth red blood cells: flattened biconcave discs with dimpled centers, flexible and slightly varied in orientation, not rings and not perfect spheres. Lin and Kai are tiny observers standing on a narrow unobtrusive translucent observation ledge at the lower edge, dwarfed by the red cells. Plasma is clear warm amber-grey, with gentle volumetric light and slow-motion flow from left to right. No cholesterol particles yet, no plaque, no dramatic blockage. Scientifically plausible spatial composition, spectacular scale.

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 尺寸按研究档案）+ 网页标注
panels.title: 油不溶于水，所以要有船
panels.prompt: A clean scientific scale tableau inside plasma: four families of lipoprotein particles suspended at different depths, all with a thin hydrophilic surface monolayer surrounding an oily core. One representative chylomicron is huge and passes softly out of focus in the far background; a smaller VLDL particle is mid-distance; a group of much smaller amber-coded LDL particles crosses the center; several tiny cool-cyan HDL particles sit near the foreground. Relative sizes are visibly ordered from largest to smallest without claiming extreme upper-range sizes. The LDL particles are slightly flattened semi-discoidal, not perfect shiny marbles. Lin and Kai stand tiny at the lower-left edge watching the size progression. No vessel-wall damage. Colors are explanatory coding, not literal molecular color.
panels.vfx: 四类颗粒的名称和尺寸范围后期叠加；琥珀与冷青只是编码色

panels.source: Blender：以小尺寸LDL样本模型为例，Berndsen & Cassidy, Nature 638, 836–843 (2025), doi:10.1038/s41586-024-08467-w
panels.title: 近看 LDL：船、腰带和货物
panels.prompt: Extreme close scientific cutaway of one LDL particle, presented as a slightly flattened semi-discoidal nanoparticle with subtle polygonal features, not a smooth sphere. A transparent phospholipid surface monolayer reveals a dense oily cholesterol-ester core suggested by many tiny packed molecular shapes, without trying to count them. Exactly ONE continuous pale-white apoB-100 protein belt wraps completely around the particle circumference, with one modest globular domain projecting from its surface; the belt is the only large protein feature. A thin white cut edge makes the cutaway readable. Lin and Kai are very small at the bottom edge, Lin indicating the single belt while Kai peers into the core. Dark uncluttered plasma background, elegant amber-coded particle and pale belt, no extra orbiting rings.
panels.vfx: ApoB 腰带亮起浅白边；结构、货物与 LDL-C 含义后期标注

panels.title: 不是坏东西，但船太多会伤血管
panels.prompt: A balanced two-part scientific moment in one continuous microscopic scene: on the left, an amber-coded LDL particle binds to a matching LDL receptor on a normal cell membrane and is being taken into a small endocytic vesicle, showing receptor-mediated uptake rather than spilling cargo; on the right, many additional LDL particles continue circulating past the cell. The single apoB belt remains visible on the particle. Lin and Kai watch from the lower edge; Lin holds one hand flat in a restrained warning gesture while Kai's expression shifts from curiosity to concern. No red warning symbols, no skulls, no text, no damaged cell. Clear visual contrast between normal uptake and excessive particle number.
panels.vfx: 正常摄取与颗粒过量同框；「必需」和「过量」后期短标注
panels.legacy_image: P06.png：仅归档；现行预览用功能示意图，不再展示旧Y形受体或错误的两组方阵。

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 转胞吞机制）
panels.title: 血管壁：不需要先破，船也能进去
panels.prompt: A cutaway of healthy arterial endothelium at cellular scale: a continuous pavement of elongated, tightly joined endothelial cells separates flowing blood above from the extracellular intima below, with no wound and no gaping hole. One amber LDL particle is enclosed inside a small transport vesicle crossing an endothelial cell from the blood side to the intima; two other particles are shown returning toward the blood side in separate vesicles, making entry and exit both visible. The particle never passes through an open crack. Lin and Kai stand tiny beside the cutaway, studying the transport route. Clean realistic tissue materials, no plaque yet, no inflammatory cells.
panels.vfx: 一颗实心粒子跨内皮；随后仅用分支示意离开与滞留，不标比例，不指定反向囊泡为唯一离开通路。

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 滞留反应）
panels.title: 关键一步：被墙里的胶粘住
panels.prompt: Within the extracellular intima just beneath an intact endothelial layer, several amber-coded LDL particles move among fine proteoglycan strands and collagen-like extracellular matrix. One particle's pale apoB belt contacts a branching proteoglycan strand and becomes retained there; other particles continue moving away, so retention is clearly selective rather than a magnetic force pulling everything. A faint localized glow marks only the contact point. Lin and Kai observe from a small cutaway ledge at the lower edge, Kai pointing to the stuck particle. No immune cells yet, no plaque, no wall rupture.
panels.vfx: 粘住的一颗停住，周围微光只标接触点；滞留计数后期叠加

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 时间快进）
panels.title: 几十年：从滞留到斑块
panels.prompt: A cinematic arterial-wall cutaway showing the progression of atherosclerosis in depth, as if years are compressed into one frame. At the near edge, retained amber LDL particles are being engulfed by translucent ivory macrophages; nearby macrophages are distended with many round lipid droplets, clearly foam cells. Deeper in the wall these accumulate into a yellow lipid-rich necrotic core, covered on the blood-facing side by a distinct smooth fibrous cap. The plaque bulges inward from WITHIN the vessel wall while the lumen remains visible above; it is not loose sludge floating in blood. Concentric amber ruler-tick ripples in the far background suggest decades passing. Lin and Kai are small observers at the edge, solemn. Anatomical, restrained, not gory.
panels.vfx: 时间涟漪代表年岁；15 → 30 → 50 岁与「脂纹≠堵塞斑块」后期叠加

panels.title: 斑块破裂：血栓堵住血管
panels.prompt: A clinically restrained close cutaway of an atherosclerotic coronary artery at the instant of plaque rupture. A thin fibrous cap over a yellow lipid core has one small visible tear; at that tear a forming red platelet-and-fibrin thrombus extends into and narrows the lumen. The structure is clear and non-gory, no blood spray, no exposed body exterior. Lin and Kai stand at the lower edge in quiet shock, with Lin already turning toward a calm view of the earlier intact vessel to signal prevention. Lighting shifts from a brief dramatic highlight on the tear to a cooler stable background, avoiding hopelessness.
panels.vfx: 裂口与血栓克制呈现；紧接冷静全景和「能提前管」

panels.source: 网页场景（纯示意 · 量 × 时间）
panels.title: 真正要看的：量 × 时间
panels.prompt: An elegant wordless scientific metaphor shown as two side-by-side time rivers over the same long span, not a mathematical formula. On the left, a sparse stream of tiny amber LDL particles flows gently for many years and leaves only a small accumulation in a vessel-wall cutaway below. On the right, a much denser stream flows over the identical time span and leaves a much larger yellow plaque accumulation. Fine concentric amber ruler-tick rings along both rivers suggest passing decades equally; no clocks, no hourglass text, no numbers. Lin and Kai stand between the two scenes comparing them, Kai thoughtful rather than frightened. Clear infographic composition with cinematic materials and generous negative space for post-production labels.
panels.vfx: 两条同年限、不同颗粒流量的对照；数字与「比喻，不是公式」后期叠加

panels.source: Blender（3D 示意 · 他汀机制）+ 网页标注
panels.title: 他汀：让肝脏收回更多 LDL
panels.prompt: A scientifically clear cinematic cutaway of a human liver and one hepatocyte, explaining a statin mechanism without any pill, packaging or treatment recommendation. Inside the hepatocyte, a generic unlabeled small molecular model occupies the catalytic pocket of an HMG-CoA reductase enzyme complex, reducing the output of the cholesterol-synthesis pathway; use a restrained pale-violet molecular shape and do not invent a readable chemical formula. As intracellular cholesterol decreases, visibly MORE LDL receptor structures appear on the hepatocyte surface. Several amber-coded LDL particles, each with one pale apoB belt, bind these receptors and are taken inside by endocytic vesicles; the surrounding bloodstream contains noticeably fewer LDL particles. A subtle split composition also shows that upstream influences such as inherited traits and aging remain present, while the number of circulating particles falls. Lin and Kai stand tiny at the lower edge observing, only these two people. Clear cause-and-effect layout, no text, no numbers, no brand, no prescription imagery.
panels.vfx: 合成减少 → 受体增多 → LDL 内吞三段联动；「减少致病原料 ≠ 消除升高原因」后期标注

panels.source: 网页场景（证据示意）+ Blender 血管
panels.title: 降低 LDL：有效，但不是解决全部风险
panels.prompt: A wordless scientific evidence tableau about lowering LDL, with Lin and Kai as the only human presenters at the lower edge. On the left, a family of blood-lipid particles is selectively reduced: fewer amber LDL particles with pale apoB belts, while cool-cyan HDL and other lipid particles remain, showing that this is not removal of all blood lipids. In the center, two artery cutaways compare more versus fewer retained LDL particles and a smaller plaque, but the treated artery still has a small stable remnant rather than becoming pristine. On the right, two equal ten-by-ten grids of simple flat circular tokens represent equal groups of people; a few tokens carry small heart-event symbols, with different absolute counts in a low-baseline-risk and a high-baseline-risk group, leaving blank areas for exact post-production numbers. Subtle background motifs for smoking, blood pressure and diabetes remain unresolved to convey residual risk. Clear balanced educational composition, no medicine bottle, no pills, no text, no readable numbers, no logos.
